query: Review a completed report for machine readability and provenance.
expected_behavior: Uses schema_version, run_id, run_timezone, data_timezone, status, source_commit, runner_version, previous_report, attempted/completed/blocked counts, truncation, and raw-data retention fields
Uses a single actual status value such as DONE, DONE_WITH_CONCERNS, or BLOCKED
Ensures finding and proposed action counts match the body
Labels implementation as none and keeps reports separate from release changes
